title: Primal Attacks
description: Roll several weapon or spell attacks at once. dnd5e's Attack Roll window (Advantage, Normal, Disadvantage) gets an Attacks field: pick how many, press a button, and every attack is rolled together and thrown together by Dice So Nice, then the damage of the hits is rolled together. With Midi-QOL, every attack still gets its own workflow (hit checks, damage, saves, effects). Can post a summary of hits and damage. Made with AI: written with Claude (Anthropic).

recommends.reason: Lets Primal Attacks share dnd5e's attack code cleanly with other modules instead of replacing it.
